description: Measured the loaf, offered the end piece, and left the papers alone.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Took the threepence, declined the plot, and offered to be dull on his behalf.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Kept the stair, off the papers.
name: Gib

description: Refused the afternoon and refused the story of the boy.
name: William Shakespeare
